verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments infrastructure platform with a Portal, so AI-generated insights over account data is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents wallets, webhooks, payouts, sandbox simulation, an llms.txt file and an agent-wallet CLI, but nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The llms.txt file and the CLI are agent-access building blocks, not in-product insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
